releases.notes:
# 2.2.5 Beta 5 - Development Snapshot 3

> WARNING, THIS IS AN **ALPHA DEVELOPMENT SNAPSHOT** which means it is **NOT** ready for production. This is the first Minecraft 1.21.11 version, and things may break. **Back up your worlds before using this build.**

## New features

### Minecraft 1.21.11 port
- **Minecraft 1.21.11 support:** ported to Minecraft 1.21.11 (alpha), using NeoForge 21.11.45, ModDevGradle 2.0.147, and Parchment 2025.12.20.
- **Per-world settings:** each world now has its own `gatheringchunks-world.toml`. Configure settings through the new **GC Settings** button on the Create World screen's More tab.
- **Global settings screen:** the main menu now provides global Debug and Performance settings, including verbose logging, performance timings, spawn search limits, chunk limits, and chunk prefetch.
- **Experimental World Scanner mode:** added an option to enable the experimental World Scanner mode.
- **Spawn theme matches the biome:** the initial spawn theme now matches the biome the player actually spawns in.

### Configuration
- **World-specific configuration:** existing worlds are migrated from the global settings. After world creation, most world settings are locked, while selected options remain editable, including chest options, block placement outside chunks, leaf decay, barriers, and fragment drops. Some settings only affect newly generated chunks.
- **Dedicated server settings:** dedicated servers use the global configuration. Clients receive the server's settings when joining and cannot submit their own settings.
- **Hosted world config saving:** `/gatheringchunks config set` now also updates the world configuration file when used in a hosted world.

## Fixes

### World generation & chunks
- **Correct ocean generation:** the ocean chunk spawner now generates actual ocean chunks instead of randomly selecting a biome that merely contains ocean.
- **Initial spawn fix:** the initial spawn is no longer repeated after restarting the world.
- **Spawn request cleanup:** fixed spawn requests that could get stuck when their target chunk was already force-loaded, leaving the source chunk loaded.
- **Engine reset cleanup:** cancelled engine resets no longer leave chunks loaded.
- **Biome-native trees:** trees are now grown from the biome's saplings instead of being assembled from manually constructed shapes.
- **Scanner coordinates:** World Scanner and Cave Scanner tooltips now display the correct chunk coordinates, including offsets.

### Server & stability
- **ChestTracker performance fix:** ChestTracker no longer loads chunks on the server thread, avoiding severe stalls that could take 27 to 31 seconds and trigger `Can't keep up` warnings.
- **Registry freezing fix:** fixed the `Tags already present before freezing` error following registry changes.
- **Client config screen crash:** fixed a double-blur crash in the configuration screen.

### Compatibility
- **Updated Minecraft APIs:** migrated server tasks, saved data handling, registry lookups, NBT getters, and client rendering to the new 1.21.11 APIs.
- **Registry compatibility:** updated block and item ID registration and added the required item definitions and recipe ingredient format changes.
- **Rendering compatibility:** updated ESP rendering for Fabric and NeoForge and adapted mixins to the new method signatures.
- **Mixin cleanup:** removed six empty or redundant mixins and replaced the bucket accessor with `BucketItem.getContent()`.

## Performance

- **Faster chunk copying:** chunk copying is now approximately **25 to 30% faster**.
- **Optimized progression helper:** replaced repeated lookups of up to 2 million positions per player every 5 minutes with reads from block entities in loaded chunks.
- **Faster spawn search:** heavily optimized the initial spawn search, making it approximately **75% faster**.
- **Optimized rain filling:** the cauldron rain filler now performs its inexpensive column check first.

...

releases.notes:
# 2.2.5 Beta 5 - Development Snapshot

> ⚠️ **DEVELOPMENT SNAPSHOT — not ready for production.** Features are still in development and things may break. **Back up your worlds before using this build.**

## Fixes

### World generation & chunks
- **Deleted chunks can no longer be regenerated by any spawner**:  the deleted-but-marked protection from the previous snapshot was silently inert: it relied on a session-only flag that was never populated in the overworld and reset on every restart, so erased chunks could be rebuilt by *any* spawner block. Spawn records are now **persisted per world** (and survive restarts), and the spawner path hard-refuses deleted chunks. The **World Mender** remains the only tool that can rebuild them.
- **Sealed-world spawner error cascade fixed**: using a Chunk Spawner in a sealed world no longer fails with "No empty adjacent chunks to expand into" followed by a raw untranslated `invalid_level_or_generator` message. Unspawned sealed chunks are classified as empty again, so expansion from your own chunk works normally; deleted chunks in sealed worlds now produce a single clear message instead of the cascade.
- **Flowing water no longer survives chunk regeneration**: erased chunks containing waterfalls, rivers or roofed water columns regenerate cleanly instead of leaving floating water columns/waterfalls and water-filled holes going straight up to the void. Lava falls included. *(Carried over from the previous snapshot's known issues.)*

### Spawner blocks
- **New refusal message for deleted chunks**: attempting to spawn into a deleted-but-marked chunk now shows: *"This chunk was already spawned and later erased. Only the World Mender can regenerate it."* (English for now; zh_cn falls back to English until translated.)

## Notes for testers

- Discord for bug reports: https://discord.gg/3S9aKukmmJ; attach `latest.log` please.

releases.notes:
# 2.2.5 Beta 5 - Development Snapshot

> ⚠️ **DEVELOPMENT SNAPSHOT — not ready for production.** Features are still in development and things may break. **Back up your worlds before using this build.**

## Fixes

### World generation & chunks
- **Themed start no longer dominates the world** — plain Chunk Spawners / Unstable Chunk Spawners now generate the world's real seed-based biomes instead of inheriting the initial theme. Already-affected saves are repaired automatically on load (no NBT surgery needed).
- **Sky/void dimensions now use real noise settings** — a new mixin (`NoiseSettingsFixMixin`) replaces the vanilla dummy noise settings the sky generator was inheriting, fixing broken terrain behavior in sky worlds.
- **`/locate` no longer hangs** — structure searches in the sky dimension are now redirected to the dimension's effective generation level.
- **Structure data is now copied with gathered chunks** — spawned chunks carry their structure starts over from the generation dimension (improves structures actually existing where they should).
- **Origin chunk protection** — spawner blocks can no longer regenerate the deleted-but-marked origin chunk (World Mender remains the intended tool); sealed-world spawn logic also treats `Sealed` generation correctly.

### Config
- **`initial_chunk_biomes` now persists** — the biome selector writes to and reads from the central config (`config/GatheringChunks/gatheringchunks.toml`), including the dedicated-server path (config sync now serializes lists). New `ListFieldMetadata` in the config system.
- **Config screen labels fixed** — the GUI now resolves `config.gatheringchunks.*` lang keys instead of the stale `config.chunkbychunk.*` prefix (labels were silently falling back to raw keys); zh_cn entries updated.

### World Mender
- **Dormancy fix** — a mender that finds nothing to generate no longer sleeps for ~16 in-game hours. New option **`emptyRescanInterval`** (1–1200000 ticks, default **600 = 30 s**) controls how often dormant menders re-scan; set `1200000` to reproduce the old behavior. Old saves with a large saved `Cooldown` drain it once first.

### Nether
- Restored vanilla **Nether coordinate scale 8** (was incorrectly `1`, so compass/coordinates were off).

### Chunk overwrite & ores
- New **`ChunkResourceTracker`** (persisted per-world) tracks which chunks have been gathered and which ore positions were harvested — on overwrite, un-mined ore is preserved and mined ores are turned into Stones/Deepslate depending on depth. Preventing "Infinite Ore" Glitches.

## New features

- **Dev Mode** — new `/gatheringchunks devmode [on|off]` (OP) toggles verbose debug logging and unlocks debug subcommands.
- **`/gatheringchunks debug chunk [x] [z]`** (OP) — compares visible vs. generation dimension state at a chunk, for diagnosing spawn/generation mismatches.
- **`/gatheringchunks config list [search]`** (OP) — list config fields and current values, with filtering.
- **`/gatheringchunks config set <field> <value>`** (OP) — set a config value from chat and save it.
- **`/gatheringchunksdev`** (client-only) — toggles a version watermark HUD.
- **Perf guard** — chunk copying logs a `[Perf]` warning when a copy pass takes >200 ms.
- **Themed spawner source option** — `ThemedSpawnerSource` config: `DIRECT` (default) or `RANDOM` source chunk for themed spawners.

## Known issues (in development)

- Manual edits to the config file are not reloaded (hot-reload / `/gatheringchunks reload` planned).
- Flowing water can survive chunk regeneration (water columns to the void).

## Notes for testers

- Discord for bug reports: https://discord.gg/3S9aKukmmJ — attach `latest.log` please.

releases.notes:
> **NOTE: I did NOT test Fabric & NeoForge on servers, only on Clients.**
> Gathering Chunks for Minecraft 26.1 & 1.21.11 is coming soon. There are a lot of API changes, which means I'll take a while to fully port the mod to those versions leading up to the 2.2.5 Release.

**Available on Fabric and NeoForge**

### Bug Fixes

* **Player Spawn Persistence**: Fixed an issue where reconnecting players would always revert back to the initial spawn chunk after a server restart. Spawn states are now properly persisted.

* **Dimension Generation**: Added saving for custom dimension generation configurations, ensuring original source dimensions are remembered across server reloads.

* **Chunk Eraser Textures**: Resolved the broken pink-and-black missing textures for the Chunk Eraser block-item in inventory views on both Common and Fabric.

* **Mushroom Chunk Spawner Recipe**: Fixed the broken recipe that made the Mushroom chunk 

---

### Changes & Improvements

**Internal Cleanup**
Removed old, legacy Pale Garden spawner assets and cleaned up the project's `.gitignore` structure.

---

### Known Issues

The following issues are known and being tracked for the stable release:

* **Performance**: The mod may cause slowdowns on low-end CPUs.
* **World Scanner**: Manual scan mode can occasionally stall or fail to complete. Restarting the scan usually resolves it.
* **Dimension Sync** *(Nether/Overworld)*: Rare desync events or failed chunk transfers between dimensions are still possible.
* **Ocean Chunk Spawner**: May not behave as intended in all cases, occasionally spawning land chunks instead of ocean chunks.

---

> If you feel any recently added feature does not fit the direction of the mod or feels out of place, feedback is genuinely appreciated. The goal is to keep Gathering Chunks focused and high quality.

Found a bug or crash? Please report it [here](https://github.com/ryvione/Gathering-Chunks/Issues) with as much detail as possible, including logs.

releases.notes:
> **NOTE: I did NOT tested Fabric & Neoforge on servers, only on Clients.**
> Gathering Chunks for Minecraft 26.1 & 1.21.11 is coming soon, there are a lot of API changes, that means i'll take a few days to fully port the mod to those versions leading to 2.2.5 Release.

**Available on Fabric and NeoForge**

### Bug Fixes
- **Cauldron Rain Filler**: Resolved a crash that could occur during world creation when the Cauldron Rain Filler was active. The root cause has been identified and patched.

---

### Changes & Improvements

**Cave Scanner**
A new Cave Scanner has been introduced. It functions similarly to the World Scanner but is designed specifically for underground cave types, allowing you to identify and locate cave biomes within chunks.

**Fragment Ores**
Fragment Ores have been added as a replacement for the chest-based system. The original chest method remains available as a toggle in the configuration file for those who prefer it.

**Update Checker: Error Handling**
Improved robustness of the Update Checker. It will now handle failures gracefully when the API server is unreachable, rather than producing errors or crashes.

**World Generation Optimization**
General optimizations have been applied to world generation to reduce overhead and improve performance during chunk loading.

**Config Screen: Scroll Limit**
A scroll limit has been added to the configuration screen to prevent unintended endless scrolling behavior.

**Biome Consistency Improvements**
Biome consistency has been improved, reducing irregularities in biome placement and transitions.

**Biome Search Improvements**
The biome searching system has been refined for more accurate and reliable results.

**Mountain Spawning**
Some adjustments have been made to mountain spawning behavior. Note that this system is still known to have issues and is being actively worked on.

---

### Known Issues
The following issues are known and being tracked for the stable release:

- **Performance**: The mod may cause slowdowns on low-end CPUs.
- **World Scanner**: Manual scan mode can occasionally stall or fail to complete. Restarting the scan usually resolves it.
- **Dimension Sync** *(Nether/Overworld)*: Rare desync events or failed chunk transfers between dimensions are still possible.
- **Fabric Version**: The Fabric build may exhibit unexpected behavior in certain cases. If you encounter issues specific to Fabric, please report them separately.
- **Ocean Chunk Spawner**: May not behave as intended in all cases, occasionally spawning land chunks instead of ocean chunks.

---

> If you feel any recently added feature does not fit the direction of the mod or feels out of place, feedback is genuinely appreciated. The goal is to keep Gathering Chunks focused and high quality.

Found a bug or crash? Please report it [here](https://github.com/ryvione/Gathering-Chunks/issues) with as much detail as possible, including logs.
